offering_description.value: Provides sample management products and multiomics services for life science customers. It sells automated sample storage systems, cryogenic storage, and consumables, and performs genomic and sample-handling services for biopharma and research labs.

primary_products.value: automated sample storage systems; cryogenic freezers; sample tubes and consumables; sample management software

primary_services.value: genomic sequencing; bioinformatics analysis; sample management services; biorepository services

customer_segment.value: B2B: biopharma and biotech companies, clinical research organizations, diagnostics firms; B2G: university and government-funded research institutes

end_markets.value: biopharma; life sciences research; clinical diagnostics; academic research

revenue_model.value: product sales: storage systems, freezers and consumables sold to labs; service fees: sequencing, sample management and biorepository services

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: builds sample storage systems and freezers, sold to research and pharma labs; service provider: takes in customer samples and data, sells sequencing and sample management services to life science companies

geography_served.value: global: customers across North America, Europe and Asia-Pacific

specialization.value: related lines: sample management products and consumables, multiomics and genomic services sharing life science customers

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: direct sales teams selling to pharma, biotech and research accounts; distributors / dealers: laboratory supply distributors in some regions

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: medical-grade and GxP quality rules for lab systems and biospecimen handling, plus data privacy rules for genomic data
